== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Five Factions Alliance is a collection of allied groups that established a makeshift encampment at the base of the [[Transcendent Ruins]]. This settlement is characterized by its disorganized appearance, consisting of ramshackle huts, shops, and dwellings constructed from fresh planks and [[stone]]. The camp is serviced by a single dirt road used by various animals to pull wagons. While the alliance functions as a unified entity intended to maintain stability before the arrival of outsiders, it is also marked by internal competition and territorial disputes. For example, the [[Sandvipers]] occupy territory based on what they can seize rather than a formal plan. The [[inhabitants]] are primarily warriors and [[sacred artists]] who have come to the ruins to seek profit by battling [[dreadbeasts]]. Among the constituent groups is the [[Jai clan]], which has long defended the area against creatures emerging from the ruins. The alliance's presence is centered around providing access to the [[Transcendent Ruins]], though different factions vie for dominance through strength and combat.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Five Factions Alliance is a group that maintains an encampment surrounding the [[Transcendent Ruins]], consisting of various territories and buildings. This settlement is constructed primarily of shacks and shops cobbled together from fresh planks, though it also includes bathhouses and is surrounded by blackened trees. While the [[Sandvipers]] occupy territory within the alliance, the group itself accounts for most of the construction in the area. The encampment serves as a location for mad experiments and is home to many [[Soulsmiths]], as well as [[Coppers]] older than six years. During the events of the story, [[Yerin]] is present in the camp, which was a site that the [[Arelius Underlord]] would have taken control of.}}
